author: claude
title: Custom terrain 28 m limit at Antarctica: existing map and Import file

requirement.text:
Android
Offline - Download a flight plan offline with custom terrain imported and make sure the custom terrain is still used when going offline

Test with terrain from various latitudes and make sure we have the same resolution constraint everywhere. e.g. ( create new sites for all of them )
Alaska
Antarctica
South Africa
Spain

source.locator: New test description, W-20261104-015 (latitudes: Antarctica; your answer: both ways)

expected: At Antarctica (-77.800000, 166.700000), in a new QA_ site: both synthetic UTM DSMs import as maps and process (status MAP). In a new flight there, Add terrain / map > Use existing map lists both; QA_<run>-28 (Antarctica_77.8S_28m_UTM.tif, app measures about 28 m) is selectable and QA_<run>-29 (Antarctica_77.8S_29m_UTM.tif, about 29 m) is listed but greyed out. Add terrain / map > Import file: Antarctica_77.8S_28m_UTM.tif shows no warning and Next is enabled; Antarctica_77.8S_29m_UTM.tif shows 'Dataset has too low resolution. Select a map with 28 m/px or finer.' and Next is disabled. Nothing in the planner is saved.

steps.text: Second Next: imports the 29 m DSM as a map into this run's own QA_ site (cloud write)
Wait for the server-side processing of both maps (10 min), then read their status in this site
steps.read_js: (async () => { const t = localStorage.getItem('accessToken') || ''; const h = {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t}; const base = 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1'; const s = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: base + '/sites', headers: h}); const sd = s.data || []; const arr = Array.isArray(sd) ? sd : (sd.items || sd.data || sd.sites || []); const site = arr.find(x => x.name === 'QA_{target} Antarctica {time}'); if (!site) return {site: false}; const l = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: base + '/datasets/sites/' + site.id, headers: h}); const out = {site: true}; for (const k of ['28', '29']) { const d = (l.data || []).find(x => x.name === 'QA_{run}-' + k); if (!d) { out[k] = null; continue; } const r = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: base + '/datasets/' + d.id + '/map-outputs', headers: h}); out[k] = {status: (r.data || {}).datasetStatus, outputs: ((r.data || {}).outputs || []).map(o => o.type + ':' + o.status)}; } return out; })()

assert.expr: v['maps']['site'] and v['maps']['28'] is not None and v['maps']['29'] is not None and v['maps']['28']['status'] == 'MAP' and v['maps']['29']['status'] == 'MAP'

steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const row = n => { const el = [...d.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === n); let r = el; for (let i = 0; i < 5 && r; i++) { r = r.parentElement; const c = r && r.querySelector('input[type=checkbox], [role=checkbox], button'); if (c) return {found: true, disabled: !!(c.disabled || c.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || c.hasAttribute('data-disabled') || (c.closest('[aria-disabled=true]')))}; } return {found: !!el, disabled: null}; }; return {m28: row('QA_{run}-28'), m29: row('QA_{run}-29')}; })()
